Venice · 2026-11-17 · City Council: Consider and Act Upon Height Exception Petition No. 26-37HE to Allow Flagpoles on a Building Exceed the Height by Right Limit of 35 Feet by 5'6" for Texas Roadhouse Located at 101 Holstein Street (Qua
item.description: approved A motion was made by Mr. Weed, seconded by Mr. Howard, that based on review of the application materials, the staff report, and testimony and evidence provided during the public hearing, the Council finds that this petition does not meet the height exception criteria in Section 1.12.3 of the Land Development Code because it does not meet 1. Compliance with all applicable elements of the Comprehensive Plan and does not meet 2. General compatibility with adjacent properties and other properties in the district, therefore moves to deny Height Exception Petition No. 26-37HE.

Venice · 2026-09-22 · City Council: Nick Dumas, Airport Director and Andrew Magenheimer, Appraiser, Slack, Johnston, and Magenheimer, Inc.: Airport Rates and Fee Adjustments and Request City Council Approval of the Proposed Adjustments
item.description: A motion was made by Mr. Howard, seconded by Vice Mayor Boldt, for a 55% increase to hangar rents beginning January 2027, implementation or increase will occur in increments of 1/3 as described by staff in 27/28/29. In year four if self-sustaining is not met an annual increase of no greater than current inflation calculation from CPI may be applied. At year five the hangar lease rate review will occur at each five-year interval. Ninety days from today's date (exact date to be determined based on Council meeting dates and schedule) a plan for reinvesting to infrastructure and particularly t-hangar will be presented to Council for review and approval by airport staff.
